plan.limits: Up to 50% of memory (best effort), keeps 10 checkpoints, keeps the computer awake, pauses on battery.
plan.plateau: Saves a checkpoint when test error improves by less than 1% across 5 checks, or after 2,000 steps.
plan.stop: Stops after 8 hours, or after 3 rounds without a better checkpoint.
plan.teacher: Polishes each checkpoint and carries the teacher's better answers forward (skipped without a teacher).
plan.worse: After 2 checkpoints in a row worse than the best: go back to the best, then halve the learning rate, then switch to the next dataset, then leave out the newest lessons. When the list runs out it stops.

session.stop: Stops after 8 hours, or after 3 rounds without a better checkpoint.
